name: kb-editor
description: KB EDITOR — Photopea-class, Photoshop-compatible image editor with a real PSD/PSB engine, running entirely in the browser. Free, offline-capable, mobile friendly.

scripts.build:vendor: esbuild js/vendor/vendor-entry.mjs --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=js/vendor/ag-psd.bundle.mjs --banner:js="/* ag-psd 34.2.0 - https://github.com/Agamnentzar/ag-psd - MIT License. Bundled for KB EDITOR. */"
scripts.test: node test/roundtrip.test.mjs && node test/smoke.test.mjs && node test/flows.test.mjs
